message: ビッグブリッジな死闘

name: Pasta
message: 「A complete and utter defeat, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「How could this happen, nya!? Last time, you got worn out right away, nya!! It was supposed to be a brilliant strategy banking on that, nya...」

name: Synn
message: 「We were doing special training while you were gone, too.」

name: Ria
message: 「In order to win, right?」

name: Pasta
message: 「What an insolent little trick, nya!! That wasn't the time to be giving you an interval, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Howeeever!! Pasta's attacks still aren't over yet, nyan!!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Yeah, over. Ode going home.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good work out there.」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-Wait just a second, nyaaa!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now then, what should we do?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyuguuu. Even if you beat Pasta now, it's already too late, nyaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Too late...?」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's right! Our preparations are already completely ready, nyan!! All that's left is... nyufufu, Bylous-nyama gets to do whatever he pleases, nya.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「What are you planning to do!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Well, that is, nya. That's... that's... umm...」

name: Pasta
message: 「I-It's a secret, nya!! There's no way I'd tell you in the first place, nya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be you don't know...?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Of course I know, nya!! Pasta and Bylous-nyama are of one mind and body, nya!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Getting an idiom wrong is proof that you're acting suspicious.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To think even Lolo-chan would call you out on that...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ginyaaa!! I have nothing left to say to you guys, nyan!! You'd better look forward to the day Bylous-nyama beats you all to a pulp, nyan!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are villains always so fast at running away?」

name: Misa
message: 「Thanks to that, we ended up not getting a single answer out of him.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't really understand what Pasta-san is talking about.」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder what the demons are aiming for... What are they planning to do...」

name: Synn
message: 「We have to investigate it ourselves.」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh.」

name: Synn
message: 「We won't figure anything out if we just keep waiting around like this. If that's the case, we have to do something about it ourselves.」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll take action ourselves and unravel the mysteries. The demons' objective, and the matter of Re-Crea. And let's make it clear what we need to do!」

name: Synn
message: 「That would be for the best, wouldn't it, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh... ah, y-yeah. Of course.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We've got the Holy Night Festival coming up too, after all. Things are gonna get busy again.」

name: Misa
message: 「Just as I'd hoped.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「U-uh~~. I'm getting all fired up--!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alri~~ght! Now that it's decided, let's immediately--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, what are we gonna do?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, as for that, we'll all think about it together from here on out...」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief. Every single time, you're all momentum and no plan.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm ashamed.」

name: Ria
message: 「No, it's fine. Synn-kun always opens up a breakthrough for us like this. You bring out everyone's spirit.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm really glad that Synn-kun became the Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, we're all pretty tired today, so let's not push ourselves and get plenty of rest, okay♪」
